level_tag: 小学三年级 · There be句型
chinese: 桌子上有三个红苹果和两根香蕉。
english: There are three red apples and two bananas on the table.
breakdown: There are [There be句型复数形式] + three red apples and two bananas [并列名词作真实主语] + on the table [地点介词短语作状语]
cultural_tip: 小学核心语法点：There be 句型的就近原则与复数可数名词加 -s/-es。

level_tag: 小学三年级 · 日常作息
chinese: 我通常在早上七点钟起床，然后吃早餐。
english: I usually get up at seven o'clock in the morning and eat breakfast.
breakdown: I [主语] + usually [频度副词] + get up [动词短语谓语] + at seven o'clock [具体时刻用介词at] + in the morning [早晨用in] + and eat breakfast [并列谓语]
cultural_tip: 小学必考介词用法：具体时刻用 at（at 7:00），早中晚用 in（in the morning/afternoon/evening）。

level_tag: 小学四年级 · 描述特征
chinese: 她有一双大大的蓝眼睛和长长的棕色卷发。
english: She has big blue eyes and long brown curly hair.
breakdown: She [第三人称单数主语] + has [have的单三谓语] + big blue eyes [多个形容词修饰可数复数] + and long brown curly hair [修饰不可数名词hair]
cultural_tip: 形容词排列口诀：大小、长短在前，颜色在后（big blue, long brown）。注意 hair 表示头发时通常为不可数名词。

level_tag: 小学四年级 · 爱好与单三
chinese: 我的妹妹喜欢在周末放风筝和踢足球。
english: My sister likes flying kites and playing soccer on weekends.
breakdown: My sister [主语单数] + likes [谓语单三] + flying kites and playing soccer [动名词短语作like的并列宾语] + on weekends [时间状语]
cultural_tip: like doing sth. 表示长期习惯与爱好；美式英语中常用 soccer 指足球，而 football 多数指美式橄榄球。

level_tag: 小学五年级 · 物主代词
chinese: 这个粉色的书包是你的，还是汤姆的？
english: Is this pink schoolbag yours, or is it Tom's?
breakdown: Is [be动词一般疑问句提前] + this pink schoolbag [主语] + yours [名词性物主代词作表语] + or [选择疑问句连词] + is it Tom's [所有格省略schoolbag]
cultural_tip: 形容词性物主代词 your 后面必须接名词（your bag），名词性物主代词 yours 相当于 your + 名词，单独作成分。

level_tag: 小学五年级 · 现在进行时
chinese: 看！两只小狗正在草地上欢快地奔跑。
english: Look! Two little puppies are running happily on the green grass.
breakdown: Look! [现在进行时标志提示词] + Two little puppies [主语复数] + are running [be doing结构谓语] + happily [副词修饰动词] + on the green grass [地点介词短语]
cultural_tip: 看到 Look! 或 Listen! 提示当下正在发生的动作，必须使用现在进行时 be + doing；run变现在分词需双写n加ing（running）。

level_tag: 小学六年级 · be going to 将来时
chinese: 明天上午我们将去动物园看大熊猫和长颈鹿。
english: We are going to visit the zoo to see giant pandas and giraffes tomorrow morning.
breakdown: We [主语] + are going to visit [be going to do一般将来时] + the zoo [宾语] + to see... [动词不定式作目的状语] + tomorrow morning [时间状语]
cultural_tip: be going to do 表示按计划、打算发生的事情；to see... 不定式作目的状语，解释去动物园的原因。

level_tag: 小学四年级 · 情态动词与乐器
chinese: 你会游泳或者弹钢琴吗？
english: Can you swim or play the piano?
breakdown: Can [情态动词提前构成疑问句] + you [主语] + swim or play [情态动词后跟动词原形] + the piano [乐器前必须加定冠词the]
cultural_tip: 小学核心考点：球类棋类前不加 the（play basketball, play chess），西洋乐器前必须加 the（play the piano, play the violin）。

level_tag: 小学三年级 · 天气与适宜活动
chinese: 今天天气阳光明媚，微风徐徐，很适合散步。
english: It is sunny and breezy today, perfect for taking a walk.
breakdown: It [代指天气的天气主语] + is sunny and breezy [be + 形容词并列作表语] + today [时间状语] + perfect for doing sth [形容词短语作补语]
cultural_tip: 英语中表达天气、时间、距离习惯用无人称代词 it 开头（It is cold today / It is 5 o'clock）。

level_tag: 小学四年级 · 文具与就近原则
chinese: 铅笔盒里有一把尺子、两支钢笔和一块橡皮。
english: There is a ruler, two pens, and an eraser in the pencil case.
breakdown: There is [be动词根据邻近主语a ruler确定单数] + a ruler, two pens, and an eraser [并列真实主语] + in the pencil case [地点介词短语]
cultural_tip: There be 就近原则：如果第一个并列名词是单数（a ruler），be 动词就用 is；即使后面有复数（two pens）。元音开头词 eraser 前用 an。

level_tag: 小学五年级 · 家务劳动与助人为乐
chinese: 吃完晚餐后，我经常帮妈妈洗碗和整理房间。
english: After dinner, I often help my mom wash dishes and clean my room.
breakdown: After dinner [时间介词短语] + I [主语] + often [频度副词] + help my mom [谓语+宾语] + wash dishes and clean my room [help sb (to) do 省略to的并列宾补]
cultural_tip: help sb. (to) do sth. 中 to 常常省略；help sb. with sth. 也是同义高频考点（如 help my mom with housework）。

level_tag: 小学五年级 · 科目爱好与原因从句
chinese: 我最喜欢的科目是科学，因为它非常有趣且神奇。
english: My favorite subject is science because it is very fun and magical.
breakdown: My favorite subject [主语] + is science [系表结构] + because [原因状语从句引导词] + it is very fun and magical [原因从句主系表]
cultural_tip: favorite 自身已含有'最喜欢'之意，切忌在前面重复加 most（不能说 my most favorite）。

level_tag: 小学六年级 · 一般过去时
chinese: 昨天是星期天，我和父母参观了科学博物馆。
english: Yesterday was Sunday, and I visited the science museum with my parents.
breakdown: Yesterday was Sunday [过去时句子] + and [并列连词] + I visited [主语+规则动词过去式visited] + the science museum [宾语] + with my parents [伴随状语]
cultural_tip: 小学语法分水岭：一般过去时的标志词 yesterday, last week, ago，动词需用过去式（visit -> visited, is -> was）。

level_tag: 小学六年级 · 形容词比较级
chinese: 这只小兔子比那只大黑狗更活泼可爱。
english: This little rabbit is cuter and livelier than that big black dog.
breakdown: This little rabbit [主语] + is cuter and livelier [形容词比较级并列作表语] + than [比较连词] + that big black dog [比较对象]
cultural_tip: 以 -e 结尾的形容词比较级直接加 -r（cute -> cuter）；以辅音字母+y结尾的改y为i加-er（lively -> livelier）。

level_tag: 小学三年级 · 交通安全与祈使句
chinese: 过马路前，请左右看两遍，注意红绿灯。
english: Look both ways before crossing the road, and watch out for the traffic lights.
breakdown: Look both ways [动词原形开头的肯定祈使句] + before crossing... [介词+动名词作时间状语] + and watch out for... [并列祈使句短语]
cultural_tip: 祈使句无主语，直接以动词原形开头；before 是介词，后面接动词时必须用 -ing 形式（crossing）。

level_tag: 小学六年级 · 正在进行时与后置定语
chinese: 教室里有几位老师正在认真批改英语作业。
english: There are several teachers correcting English homework in the classroom.
breakdown: There are several teachers [There be句型] + correcting English homework [现在分词短语作后置定语修饰teachers] + in the classroom [地点状语]
cultural_tip: There be sb. doing sth. 是小学高年级拔高句型，表示'有某人正在做某事'，非常地道。

level_tag: 小学三年级 · 礼貌点餐与不可数名词
chinese: 我想要一杯温牛奶和两块草莓蛋糕。
english: I would like a glass of warm milk and two slices of strawberry cake, please.
breakdown: I would like [礼貌表达想要] + a glass of warm milk [量词短语修饰不可数名词milk] + and two slices of strawberry cake [量词复数修饰cake] + please [礼貌用语]
cultural_tip: 不可数名词（milk, water, bread）必须通过量词来表示复数（a glass of, two slices of, three cups of）。

level_tag: 小学五年级 · both...and 并列句
chinese: 我们的学校既美丽又宽敞，老师们都非常和蔼可亲。
english: Our school is both beautiful and spacious, and all the teachers are very kind.
breakdown: Our school is both beautiful and spacious [both...and连接并列形容词] + and [连接并列从句] + all the teachers are very kind [主系表结构]
cultural_tip: both A and B 连接并列成分，意为'两者都；既……又……'，谓语动词一律用复数。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · 定语从句 (who/that)
chinese: 这就是昨天在校门口借给我自行车的那个男孩。
english: This is the boy who lent me his bicycle at the school gate yesterday.
breakdown: This is the boy [主干句] + who [关系代词指人作从句主语] + lent me his bicycle [双宾语结构] + at the school gate yesterday [地点与时间状语]
cultural_tip: 中考必考：先行词为人（the boy）且在从句中作主语时，关系代词用 who 或 that；注意 lend 的过去式为不规则动词 lent。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · 宾语从句 (whether/if)
chinese: 我还没决定下周六是否参加英语演讲比赛。
english: I haven't decided whether I should take part in the English speech contest next Saturday.
breakdown: I haven't decided [现在完成时否定主干] + whether [连词意为'是否'] + I should take part in... [陈述语序的宾语从句]
cultural_tip: 中考核心铁律：宾语从句无论主句是陈述句还是疑问句，从句内部永远使用【陈述语序】（主语+谓语，不可倒装）。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · 一般过去时被动语态
chinese: 这座著名的古老石桥是在三百多年前建成的。
english: This famous ancient stone bridge was built more than three hundred years ago.
breakdown: This famous ancient stone bridge [主语被动承受者] + was built [一般过去时被动语态 was + 过去分词built] + more than three hundred years ago [时间状语]
cultural_tip: 被动语态结构：be + 过去分词（done）；hundred 前有具体数字时不加-s（three hundred），后面加-s时接of（hundreds of people）。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · 让步状语从句
chinese: 虽然外面正下着倾盆大雨，但他依然按时到达了学校。
english: Although it was raining heavily outside, he still arrived at school on time.
breakdown: Although [让步状语从句引导词] + it was raining heavily [过去进行时从句] + he still arrived at school on time [主句]
cultural_tip: 中考易错雷区：Although/Though 与 but 不能在同一个句子中同时连用（有 although 就不能有 but）。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · 现在完成时 (since)
chinese: 自从去年搬到新城市以来，我已经读了二十多本英文原版书。
english: I have read over twenty original English books since I moved to this new city last year.
breakdown: I have read [现在完成时 have + 过去分词] + over twenty... [宾语] + since [自……以来] + I moved... [since引导一般过去时时间状语从句]
cultural_tip: 中考经典搭配：主句用现在完成时（have/has done），since 从句用一般过去时（did）。read 的过去分词书写相同但发音为 /red/。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · so... that... 结果状语从句
chinese: 他跑得如此之快，以至于全班同学都为他欢呼喝彩。
english: He ran so fast that all his classmates cheered loudly for him.
breakdown: He ran [主谓] + so fast [so+副词] + that [结果状语从句引导词] + all his classmates cheered loudly for him [结果状语从句]
cultural_tip: 辨析考点：so + 形容词/副词 + that；such + a/an + 形容词 + 单数名词 + that。如 such a fast runner that...

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · Would you mind doing 礼貌请求
chinese: 你介意把窗户打开让新鲜空气流进来吗？
english: Would you mind opening the window to let some fresh air in?
tokens: to let some fresh air in?
breakdown: Would you mind [礼貌询问句型] + opening the window [mind后必须接动名词doing] + to let... [不定式作目的状语]
cultural_tip: 中考交际用语考点：回答'不介意（同意开窗）'要用 No, not at all. 或 Of course not；回答'介意'才用 I'm sorry, but...

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · 动名词作主语
chinese: 坚持每天早晨朗读英语不仅能提高口语，还能增强自信心。
english: Reading English aloud every morning not only improves speaking skills but also builds confidence.
breakdown: Reading English aloud every morning [动名词短语作单数主语] + not only improves... but also builds... [谓语动词单三形式并列]
cultural_tip: 动名词（短语）作主语时，谓语动词一律用单数形式（improves, builds）；not only... but also...遵循就近一致原则。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · would rather do than do
chinese: 我宁愿在图书馆安静地自习，也不想去拥挤嘈杂的商场。
english: I would rather study quietly in the library than go to the crowded shopping mall.
breakdown: I [主语] + would rather [情态结构宁愿] + study quietly... [动词原形] + than [连词胜过] + go to... [动词原形与study平行并列]
cultural_tip: 中考高频句型：would rather do A than do B（宁愿做A也不做B），两者都必须使用动词原形；等同于 prefer doing A to doing B。

level_tag: 中考拔高考点 · Only by 倒装句
chinese: 只有通过坚持不懈的练习，我们才能真正掌握一门外语。
english: Only by practicing constantly can we truly master a foreign language.
breakdown: Only by practicing constantly [Only+介词短语置于句首] + can we [部分倒装，助动词提前] + truly master a foreign language [真实谓语动词与宾语]
cultural_tip: 中考与高考衔接考点：'Only + 状语'置于句首时，主句必须采用部分倒装语序（将助动词/情态动词提到主语前面）。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · too... to... 句型
chinese: 这道数学难题太复杂了，那个初学者几乎无法独立解出来。
english: This math problem is too complicated for the beginner to solve on his own.
breakdown: This math problem [主语] + is too complicated [too+形容词表否定意义'太……'] + for the beginner [逻辑主语] + to solve on his own [不定式作结果状语]
cultural_tip: too... to... 结构表示'太……而不能……'，表否定含义；可以与 so... that... can't 互相改写。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · suggest 虚拟语气/动名词
chinese: 英语老师建议我们每天抽出二十分钟跟读原版音频。
english: Our English teacher suggested that we spend twenty minutes shadowing native audio every day.
breakdown: Our English teacher [主语] + suggested [谓语] + that we (should) spend... [宾语从句虚拟语气，省略should后用原形spend] + shadowing... [spend time doing sth]
cultural_tip: suggest 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气：(should) + 动词原形；此外 suggest 不能用 suggest sb to do，只能用 suggest doing sth。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · used to vs be used to
chinese: 他过去常常步行去上学，但现在习惯骑共享单车了。
english: He used to walk to school, but now he is used to riding a shared bicycle.
tokens: He used to walk to school,
but now he is used to
breakdown: He used to walk... [used to do 表示'过去常常做某事，现在不做了'] + but now [转折] + he is used to riding... [be used to doing 表示'现在习惯于做某事']
cultural_tip: 中考必考对比：used to do（过去常常），be used to doing（习惯于），be used to do（被用来做某事）。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · 最高级与定语从句
chinese: 这是我至今为止看过的最令人振奋、最有启发性的演讲。
english: This is the most inspiring speech that I have ever listened to so far.
tokens: This is the most inspiring speech
breakdown: This is the most inspiring speech [最高级主干句] + that [先行词有最高级修饰时，关系代词只能用that] + I have ever listened to so far [从句中listen to的介词to不能遗漏]
cultural_tip: 当先行词被形容词最高级（the most inspiring）修饰时，关系代词只能用 that，不能用 which。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · 感叹句 (What vs How)
chinese: 多棒的一个好主意啊！我们为什么不现在就行动呢？
english: What a brilliant idea it is! Why don't we put it into practice right now?
tokens: What a brilliant idea it is!
breakdown: What a brilliant idea it is! [What + a/an + 形容词 + 单数名词 + 主谓感叹句] + Why don't we do sth? [表提议的疑问句]
cultural_tip: 感叹句口诀：名词在前用 What（What a good day!），形容词/副词在前用 How（How beautiful the flowers are!）。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · The more... the more...
chinese: 我们准备得越充分，中考考场上就会越感到自信从容。
english: The more fully we prepare, the more confident we will feel during the examination.
breakdown: The more fully we prepare [the+比较级+主谓从句] + the more confident we will feel [the+比较级+主谓主句] + during the examination [介词时间状语]
cultural_tip: 'The + 比较级..., the + 比较级...' 意为'越……就越……'，前后结构对称，前从后主，从句常用一般现在时表将来。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · 条件状语从句 (主将从现)
chinese: 如果明天下午不下雨的话，我们就去湖畔公园举行野餐。
english: If it doesn't rain tomorrow afternoon, we will have a picnic by the lakeside park.
breakdown: If it doesn't rain tomorrow afternoon [if引导条件状语从句，用一般现在时表将来] + we will have a picnic [主句用一般将来时] + by the lakeside park [地点状语]
cultural_tip: 中考黄金考点【主将从现】：在 if 条件状语从句和 as soon as / when 时间状语从句中，主句如果是一般将来时，从句必须用一般现在时。

level_tag: 中考核心考点 · It is + adj + for/of sb to do
chinese: 对中学生而言，养成良好的自主学习习惯是非常必要的。
english: It is essential for middle school students to develop good self-study habits.
breakdown: It [形式主语] + is essential [系动词+形容词表语] + for middle school students [逻辑主语] + to develop good self-study habits [动词不定式作真正主语]
cultural_tip: It is + adj. + for sb. to do sth.：当形容词描述事物属性时用 for（essential, important, necessary）；描述人的性格品质时用 of（kind, brave, polite）。

level_tag: 日常高频 · 基础点单
chinese: 我想要一杯大杯冰燕麦拿铁，不要加糖。
english: I would like a large iced oat latte with no sugar please.
breakdown: I would like [礼貌提出需求] + a large iced oat latte [杯型+冷热+奶基底+品类] + with no sugar please [定制糖度要求]
cultural_tip: 国外咖啡馆默认提供全脂奶（whole milk），常见植物奶有燕麦奶（oat milk）、杏仁奶（almond milk）和大豆奶（soy milk）。

level_tag: 地道表达 · 替换食材
chinese: 请问我可以把全脂牛奶换成低脂杏仁奶吗？
english: Could I substitute the whole milk with almond milk?
breakdown: Could I [委婉请求语气] + substitute A with B [用B替换A动词短语] + the whole milk [原食材] + with almond milk [替换目标]
cultural_tip: substitute A with B 或者 ask for almond milk instead 是母语者最自然的地道换配料说法。

level_tag: 实用场景 · 堂食与外带
chinese: 咖啡我在这里喝，另外帮我打包一个现烤的蓝莓可颂。
english: The coffee is for here, and could you wrap a blueberry croissant to go?
breakdown: for here [堂食固定短语] + and could you wrap [请求打包] + a blueberry croissant [烘焙点心] + to go [外带固定短语]
cultural_tip: 点餐结算最后，店员必然询问：'For here or to go?'（美式），英式通常问：'Having here or taking away?'。

level_tag: 精品咖啡 · 风味描述
chinese: 今天的特调手冲咖啡口感带有柑橘和茉莉花香。
english: Today's special pour-over coffee has distinct notes of citrus and jasmine.
breakdown: Today's special pour-over coffee [特调手冲咖啡主语] + has distinct notes of [具有明显……风味笔触] + citrus and jasmine [柑橘与茉莉宾语]
cultural_tip: 品鉴咖啡或红酒时，'notes of...' 或 'hints of...' 专指香气与风味层次，比直接说 flavor 更加专业地道。

level_tag: 结账买单 · 分开支付
chinese: 我们想分开买单，请问支持微信支付或苹果支付吗？
english: We would like to split the bill, do you accept Apple Pay?
breakdown: We would like to [礼貌意图] + split the bill [AA制/分单固定短语] + do you accept Apple Pay [询问移动支付通道]
cultural_tip: 聚餐分单结账时说 'split the bill' 或 'separate checks'，若想表达'我请客'可以说 'It's on me' 或 'My treat'。

level_tag: 调节浓淡 · 贴心要求
chinese: 这杯美式咖啡对我来说有点太浓了，能帮我加点热水吗？
english: This Americano is a bit too strong for me, could you top it off with some hot water?
tokens: a bit too strong for me,
breakdown: a bit too strong for me [主系表形容浓烈度] + could you top it off with... [短语top off意为'加满/添上'] + some hot water [热水]
cultural_tip: top off 是美式日常口语超高频表达，比如加水、加咖啡或给汽车加满油都可以用 top off。

level_tag: 特殊需求 · 脱因咖啡
chinese: 请问你们店里有推荐的不含咖啡因的饮品吗？
english: Do you have any decaf options that you would personally recommend?
breakdown: Do you have any decaf options [基础疑问句] + that you would personally recommend [定语从句修饰options]
cultural_tip: decaf 是 decaffeinated 的口语简写，指脱因咖啡；茶类中的无咖啡因草本茶通常叫 herbal tea。

level_tag: 环境卫生 · 礼貌要求
chinese: 服务员，能麻烦帮我们把靠窗的那张空桌子擦一下吗？
english: Excuse me, could you please wipe down that empty table by the window?
breakdown: Excuse me [礼貌打招呼短语] + could you please wipe down [擦拭干净动词短语] + that empty table [宾语] + by the window [介词短语作后置定语]
cultural_tip: wipe down 是清洁台面、桌椅的标准短语；by the window 意为靠窗的。

level_tag: 甜点口感 · 地道赞美
chinese: 这里的招牌提拉米苏甜而不腻，入口即化。
english: Their signature tiramisu is perfectly balanced and literally melts in your mouth.
breakdown: Their signature tiramisu [招牌提拉米苏主语] + is perfectly balanced [风味平衡甜而不腻] + and literally melts in your mouth [入口即化比喻]
cultural_tip: 形容美食'甜而不腻'在英文中最佳地道表达是 'not overly sweet' 或 'perfectly balanced'；'melts in your mouth'是入口即化。

level_tag: 出行必备 · 航班值机
chinese: 您好，我想办理登机手续，并托运这两件大行李箱。
english: I would like to check in for my flight and check these two bags.
breakdown: check in for my flight [办理登机手续短语] + and check these two bags [动词check在此表示托运行李]
cultural_tip: 注意 check 的双重含义：'check in'是值机/入住，而'check bags'直接意为托运行李；随身行李叫 carry-on。

level_tag: 机位选择 · 靠窗座位
chinese: 如果还有空位的话，我能选一个靠窗的座位吗？
english: Could I possibly have a window seat if one is still available?
breakdown: Could I possibly have [极其礼貌的请求表达] + a window seat [靠窗座位] + if one is still available [条件状语从句]
cultural_tip: 飞机座位两大核心词：靠窗位 a window seat；靠走道位 an aisle seat（注意 aisle 中 s 不发音，读 /aɪl/）。

level_tag: 航站楼交通 · 穿梭巴士
chinese: 请问去往二号航站楼的免费穿梭巴士在哪个站台乘坐？
english: Where can I catch the free shuttle bus to Terminal 2?
breakdown: Where can I [询问地点疑问句] + catch the free shuttle bus [乘坐免费穿梭巴士动宾短语] + to Terminal 2 [目的地介词短语]
cultural_tip: 机场/酒店间往返的中巴叫 shuttle bus；catch 或 take 表示搭乘。

level_tag: 突发求助 · 行李延误申报
chinese: 我的行李箱似乎在传送带上丢失了，我该去哪里申报？
english: My suitcase seems to be missing from the carousel, where should I report it?
breakdown: My suitcase [主语] + seems to be missing [似乎不见了] + from the carousel [行李提取转盘] + where should I report it [咨询申报处]
cultural_tip: 行李提取转盘专业英文是 carousel（或 baggage claim）；遗失行李申报柜台是 Lost and Found 或 Baggage Service Desk。

level_tag: 海关入境 · 旅行目的陈述
chinese: 我来这里进行为期两周的家庭观光度假旅行。
english: I am here for a two-week sightseeing vacation with my family.
breakdown: I am here for [入境回答标准句型] + a two-week [复合形容词修饰vacation] + sightseeing vacation [观光度假] + with my family [伴随状语]
cultural_tip: 海关入境官最常问：'What is the purpose of your visit?'（来访目的）。答：'Vacation' 或 'Sightseeing' 即可，千万不要说 work。

level_tag: 市内问路 · 地铁出行时间
chinese: 请问从这里到大英博物馆乘地铁大约需要多长时间？
english: How long does it take to get to the British Museum by subway?
tokens: to get to the British Museum
breakdown: How long does it take [询问花费时间的固定句型] + to get to the British Museum [不定式到达目的地] + by subway [交通方式状语]
cultural_tip: How long does it take to do sth 是询问交通或耗时的万能黄金句型；伦敦地铁叫 the Tube 或 Underground，纽约叫 Subway。

level_tag: 酒店入住 · 预订与登记
chinese: 您好，我预订了一间大床房，这是我的护照和确认订单。
english: Hello, I have a reservation for a king-size room, here is my passport and confirmation.
breakdown: I have a reservation for... [标准酒店入住开头] + a king-size room [大床房] + here is my passport and confirmation [倒装句呈递证件]
cultural_tip: 酒店床型常见分级：Single bed（单人床）、Queen-size bed（标准双人床/大床）、King-size bed（特大号豪华床）。

level_tag: 交通换乘 · 高铁停靠站
chinese: 这趟去往市中心的高铁会在哪一个火车站停靠？
english: Which station does this express train to downtown stop at?
breakdown: Which station [疑问词] + does this express train to downtown [主语] + stop at [动介短语停靠]
cultural_tip: express train 表示特快/高铁；stop at 指停靠某站；downtown 在英文中是副词也是名词，表示市中心。

level_tag: 境外生活 · 寻找ATM取现
chinese: 抱歉打扰一下，请问附近有可以用银联卡取现的自动提款机吗？
english: Excuse me, is there an ATM nearby where I can withdraw local cash?
tokens: Excuse me, is there an ATM nearby
breakdown: is there an ATM nearby [There be疑问句] + where [关系副词引导地点定语从句] + I can withdraw local cash [提取当地现金]
cultural_tip: ATM 是 Automated Teller Machine 的缩写；'取钱'动词是 withdraw cash，'存钱'动词是 deposit。

level_tag: 敏捷协作 · 每日晨会
chinese: 让我们快速开一个五分钟的站立晨会，同步今日工作进展。
english: Let's have a quick standup meeting to sync on today's progress.
breakdown: Let's have a quick standup meeting [祈使句发起会议] + to sync on... [不定式作目的状语，sync on 同步]
cultural_tip: 外企高频词：standup meeting 指站会（短小精悍）；sync 是 synchronize 的缩写，表示'同步进度/对齐信息'。

level_tag: 邮件与交付 · 截止时间
chinese: 我会在今天下班前把更新后的项目时间表发邮件给你。
english: I will email you the updated project timeline by the end of today.
breakdown: I will email you [双宾语结构，email用作及物动词] + the updated project timeline [直接宾语] + by the end of today [时间截止介词短语]
cultural_tip: 职场缩写常用 EOD（End of Day，下班前）或 COB（Close of Business）；'by' 表达'不晚于……时刻'。

level_tag: 会议主持 · 礼貌收尾
chinese: 感谢大家参会，如果大家没有其他疑问，我们今天就到这里。
english: Thank you for joining, if there are no further questions, let's wrap up.
tokens: if there are no further questions,
breakdown: Thank you for joining [感谢参会] + if there are no further questions [条件从句] + let's wrap up [动词短语收尾会议]
cultural_tip: wrap up 是职场主持会议结束的最地道口头语，相当于 finish 或 conclude。

level_tag: 任务委派 · 索取报告
chinese: 能麻烦你在周五下午三点前把季度营销报告发给我吗？
english: Could you please send over the quarterly marketing report by three PM on Friday?
breakdown: Could you please send over [委婉请求发文件] + the quarterly marketing report [季度营销报告] + by three PM on Friday [具体截止时间]
cultural_tip: send over 比单纯的 send 更有'隔空转交递送过来'的职场客气感；quarterly 意为季度的。

level_tag: 团队决策 · 方案采纳
chinese: 经过深入讨论，我们团队决定采纳第二套产品设计方案。
english: After thorough discussion, the team decided to adopt the second product design proposal.
breakdown: After thorough discussion [介词短语充当状语] + the team decided to adopt [主干句] + the second product design proposal [宾语]
cultural_tip: thorough /'θʌrə/ 表示彻底深入的；adopt 意为采纳方案/通过决议（注意不要与 adapt 适应 混淆）。

level_tag: 职场请假 · 年假申请
chinese: 下周我想请两天年假来处理一些个人紧急事务。
english: I would like to take two days of annual leave next week to handle some personal matters.
breakdown: take two days of annual leave [休两天年假] + next week [时间状语] + to handle some personal matters [不定式作目的状语]
cultural_tip: 休假常见术语：annual leave（年假）、sick leave（病假）、personal leave（事假）、maternity leave（产假）。

level_tag: 业务汇报 · 价值阐述
chinese: 这个新功能不仅能提升用户留存率，还能大幅降低运营成本。
english: This new feature will not only boost user retention but also significantly cut operational costs.
breakdown: This new feature will [主语+助动词] + not only boost user retention [动宾短语1] + but also significantly cut [动宾短语2] + operational costs [运营成本]
cultural_tip: 职场关键 KPI 术语：user retention（用户留存率）、conversion rate（转化率）、cost reduction（成本削减）。

level_tag: 排期取舍 · 紧急故障
chinese: 我们需要优先排查这个紧急线上故障，然后再推进新功能开发。
english: We need to prioritize fixing this urgent production bug before rolling out new features.
breakdown: prioritize doing sth [优先处理某事] + this urgent production bug [线上生产环境紧急故障] + before rolling out new features [在发布新功能之前]
cultural_tip: production bug 专指已经上线、影响真实用户的 bug（非测试环境）；roll out 是发布上线新功能的标准行业短语。

level_tag: 周末社交 · 破冰问候
chinese: 你周末过得怎么样？有没有去探索什么有趣的新餐厅？
english: How was your weekend? Did you discover any fun new restaurants or cafes?
breakdown: How was your weekend [周一最经典的破冰问句] + Did you discover any fun new restaurants [一般过去时追问细节]
cultural_tip: 周一与欧美同事或朋友寒暄，'How was your weekend?' 是绝对标准开场白，通常简短分享一两句有趣的事情即可。

level_tag: 同理心共鸣 · 情绪支持
chinese: 我完全理解你的感受，遇到这种突发情况任何人都会沮丧的。
english: I totally understand how you feel, anyone would be frustrated in this situation.
breakdown: I totally understand [完全赞同并理解] + how you feel [宾语从句] + anyone would be frustrated [虚拟安慰主干] + in this situation [处境状语]
cultural_tip: 安慰朋友时避免直接说大道理，先用 'I totally get you' 或 'I can imagine how tough that was' 建立情感共鸣连接。

level_tag: 临时邀约 · 散步邀约
chinese: 晚风这么舒服，下班后要不要一起沿着江边散散步吹吹风？
english: The breeze is so refreshing, do you want to take a walk along the river after work?
tokens: take a walk along the river
breakdown: The breeze is so refreshing [环境烘托] + do you want to take a walk [随性邀约] + along the river [地点短语] + after work [时间状语]
cultural_tip: refreshing 形容微风、冷饮或洗澡后'令人神清气爽的'；take a walk along... 是沿着……散步。

level_tag: 温暖陪伴 · 随叫随到
chinese: 别担心，一切都会好起来的，有任何需要随时给我发微信。
english: Don't worry, everything will turn out fine, I am always here if you need anything.
breakdown: Don't worry [祈使句安慰] + everything will turn out fine [固定成语'一切终将好转'] + I am always here [温暖承诺] + if you need anything [条件从句]
cultural_tip: 'turn out fine' 意思是结局终究会变好；'I am always here for you' 是母语者最暖心的陪伴金句。

level_tag: 兴趣爱好 · 追剧与阅读
chinese: 你最近在追什么好看的电视剧，或者读什么启发灵感的好书吗？
english: Have you been binge-watching any good shows or reading inspiring books lately?
breakdown: Have you been doing [现在完成进行时，强调近期的持续动作] + binge-watching [刷剧动词短语] + any good shows or reading... [并列宾语]
cultural_tip: binge-watch 是当代流行俚语，专门指'一口气连看多集刷剧'；lately 意为最近、近来。

level_tag: 热门资讯 · 网红展览
chinese: 我听说市中心新开了一家沉浸式光影美术馆，门票卖得特别火爆。
english: I heard an immersive digital art museum opened downtown and tickets are selling out fast.
breakdown: I heard [主句听说] + an immersive digital art museum opened downtown [省略that的宾语从句] + tickets are selling out fast [并列现在进行时]
cultural_tip: immersive 意为'沉浸式的'（当下最热词汇之一）；sell out 指票或商品售罄。

level_tag: 时光感慨 · 故友重聚
chinese: 时间过得真快啊，感觉我们上次一起喝咖啡聊天还是在夏天呢。
english: Time flies so fast, it feels like we just met for coffee yesterday back in summer.
tokens: it feels like we just met
breakdown: Time flies so fast [感叹光阴飞逝] + it feels like [感觉就像是……] + we just met for coffee yesterday [从句] + back in summer [时间状语回忆夏天]
cultural_tip: Time flies 是'时光飞逝'的最地道成语；it feels like... 可以接句子，表达主观直觉或时光错觉。

level_tag: 热情赞美 · 讨教厨艺
chinese: 这道自制焦糖布丁简直太好吃了，你必须把独家秘方分享给我！
english: This homemade pudding tastes absolutely incredible, you definitely have to share your secret recipe with me!
tokens: share your secret recipe with me!
breakdown: This homemade pudding [自制布丁主语] + tastes absolutely incredible [系表结构，尝起来极其不可思议] + you definitely have to share... [热情强烈的半开玩笑要求]
cultural_tip: 英语赞美朋友厨艺，可以用 incredible, heavenly, out of this world，效果远比单纯的 delicious 生动十倍。

level_tag: 专柜选购 · 尺码咨询
chinese: 请问这件淡紫色的羊绒开衫毛衣有大一号的尺码吗？
english: Do you happen to have this lavender cashmere cardigan in a larger size?
breakdown: Do you happen to have [极为地道客气的询问'你们恰好有……吗'] + this lavender cashmere cardigan [淡紫色羊绒开衫] + in a larger size [更大号尺码]
cultural_tip: 'Do you happen to have...?' 比硬邦邦的 'Do you have...?' 更加优雅有礼貌；开衫叫 cardigan。

level_tag: 服装试穿 · 试衣间指引
chinese: 请问试衣间在哪里？我可以试穿一下这两条复古牛仔裤吗？
english: Where is the fitting room? May I try on these two pairs of vintage jeans?
breakdown: Where is the fitting room [询问试衣间位置] + May I try on [试穿衣物动宾短语] + these two pairs of vintage jeans [量词短语修饰裤子复数]
cultural_tip: 试衣间叫 fitting room（美）或 changing room（英）；try on 是可拆动词短语（try them on）。

level_tag: 试穿反馈 · 舒适轻盈
chinese: 这双运动跑鞋穿起来非常轻便透气，而且走起路来格外舒服。
english: These running sneakers are very lightweight and breathable, and extremely comfortable to walk in.
breakdown: These running sneakers [主语复数] + are very lightweight and breathable [并列形容词] + and extremely comfortable to walk in [动词不定式充当形容词补足语]
cultural_tip: 运动鞋在美式叫 sneakers，英式叫 trainers；'comfortable to walk in' 中介词 in 必须保留，指穿在鞋里走。

level_tag: 售后政策 · 凭票退换
chinese: 如果尺码不合身的话，在七天内凭购物小票可以退换吗？
english: If the size doesn't fit, can I exchange it with the receipt within seven days?
breakdown: If the size doesn't fit [条件状语从句] + can I exchange it [询问换货] + with the receipt [凭小票介词短语] + within seven days [在七天之内]
cultural_tip: 退货是 refund（退钱），换货是 exchange（换尺码/颜色）；receipt（发音 /rɪ'siːt/，注意 p 不发音）是购物收据。

level_tag: 折扣促销 · 买二赠一
chinese: 这家精品店目前正在进行季末大促销，全场服装买二送一。
english: This boutique is running an end-of-season sale where everything is buy two get one free.
breakdown: is running an end-of-season sale [举办季末促销] + where [关系副词引导定语从句修饰sale] + everything is buy two get one free [买二送一]
cultural_tip: '买二赠一'英文缩写为 BOGO（Buy One Get One）系列的 'Buy 2 Get 1 Free'；季末大促是 end-of-season sale。

level_tag: 电子数码 · 质保咨询
chinese: 请问这款头戴式无线降噪耳机的官方保修期有多久？
english: How long is the official warranty period for these wireless noise-canceling headphones?
breakdown: How long is [询问时长] + the official warranty period [官方质保期主语] + for these wireless noise-canceling headphones [介词短语修饰主语]
cultural_tip: warranty 是保修期；noise-canceling 是降噪（主动降噪技术 ANC: Active Noise Cancellation）。

level_tag: 挑选礼品 · 畅销推荐
chinese: 我想给好朋友挑一份生日礼物，请问你们店里最热销的是哪一款？
english: I want to pick a birthday gift for my best friend, what is your top best-seller?
breakdown: I want to pick a birthday gift for my best friend [表达挑礼物意图] + what is your top best-seller [询问头号热销爆款]
cultural_tip: best-seller 指爆款/最畅销产品；或者也可以问 'What is your most popular item?'。

level_tag: 通勤穿搭 · 实用百搭
chinese: 这款托特包既轻巧时尚又很能装，非常适合日常通勤和逛街。
english: This tote bag is both lightweight and stylish, making it perfect for daily commuting.
breakdown: This tote bag is both lightweight and stylish [主系表结构] + making it perfect for... [现在分词短语作伴随状语与结果补充] + daily commuting [日常通勤]
cultural_tip: tote bag 是托特包（大容量便携手提包）；daily commuting 指日常上下班通勤。

level_tag: 小学 PEP · 经典例句
chinese: 我们试试看！
english: Let's have a try.
